title: skills/ticks docs still document the deleted tk herd spawn/wait/collect/reconcile/cleanup/notify/paint/watch/plugin commands
body: skills/ticks/SKILL.md, references/tk-commands.md, references/runners-config.md, references/herdr-kinds.md, references/run-charter.md, references/pi-runner.md, references/herdr-runner.md and references/agent-runner.md all reference the herd execution commands this tick deleted. Updating operator-facing skill docs was out of scope for a code-deletion tick and I did not touch them, but they are now stale and should be reconciled once the ticfac-side replacement commands/workflow are settled.
